title: Family belongings
questions: What are the main ideas you learned from this episode? Please give a brief summary in your own words.
Why do ordinary family objects sometimes become emotionally valuable?
Which possession in your family has a story behind it?
Should valuable family belongings automatically go to the oldest child, or should families decide differently?
Can keeping too many sentimental objects become a burden?
If you could preserve only one family object for the next generation, what would you choose?
